scope: materialize the already-selected train-fitted DOFA-v2 folds-3/4 probe as a label-free external inference state

endpoint_contract.construction: for each fixed projection seed, fit one endpoint on fold 4 for the held-fold-3 role and one endpoint on fold 3 for the held-fold-4 role
endpoint_contract.first_normalization: mean/std fit only on the endpoint fit fold
endpoint_contract.projection: fixed sparse random projection determined only by seed and feature width
endpoint_contract.second_normalization: projected mean/std fit only on the endpoint fit fold
endpoint_contract.classifier: fixed C=0.01 logistic regression and original class weighting/random-state contract
endpoint_contract.external_aggregation: apply every endpoint unchanged to every external row, average all ten logits equally, then sigmoid

invariants: This is deterministic materialization of the already-selected folds-3/4 probe, not retraining for candidate selection.
The materializer opens only the existing folds-3/4 DOFA feature cache and never opens fold-0, fold-1, fold-2, official-test, or external data.
No Stanford feature, label, release rate, or detector outcome may be accessed before this state is written and hash-bound into the Stanford scoring protocol.
The output contains inference parameters and provenance only; it contains no development labels or sample outcomes.
Changing endpoint weighting, projection seeds, feature set, normalization, C, or gate requires a new preregistered development hypothesis and cannot be selected on Stanford.
